The third project in CMSC405 involved performing rudimentary text analysis on a text dataset of our choice, and delivering the findings of our analysis in a blog style format. My partner Laura Henze and I chose to analyze a large TedTalk dataset, which contains the full transcripts for a wide variety TedTalks. Our full blog post is embedded below.
